widths.boundary_rule: Author reports jet narrower than 28 km. Velocity cutoff and paired edges unresolved; peak 28 cm/s and broader-flow speed about 10 cm/s are not boundary thresholds.
widths.extraction_method: Reported qualifier, reference scale and date transcribed from primary publisher indexed body/captions; original PDF/pixels and fields not acquired or digitized.
widths.geographic_scope: Riiser-Larsenisen continental shelf/slope, southeastern Weddell Sea; section 2 offshore narrow jet embedded in broader southwestward flow. No exact paired geographic width limits supplied.
widths.layer: Detided LADCP horizontal-current context at 100 m (paragraph 5 and Figure 1). Surface-intensified jet; no uniform vertical width slab inferred. 3000 m isobath describes bottom topography.
widths.name: Antarctic Slope Current

original_regional_context.display_aria_label: Antarctic Slope Current narrow jet: source reports less than 28 km on 23 February 2009, in 100 m detided LADCP context. No point width, lower bound, zero-to-28 interval, confidence guarantee or full-current envelope.
original_regional_context.display_caption: Source reports a narrow southwestward jet <28 km on 23 February 2009, within broader slower southwestward flow. Representative width, lower bound and numeric uncertainty remain unknown.
original_regional_context.display_method_note: Primary publisher indexed text/captions reviewed; original PDF and figure pixels unavailable. 100 m is the horizontal-current context; 3000 m is bottom topography. Peak 28 cm/s and background about 10 cm/s are not width cutoffs. No annual range or mapped width band.
original_regional_context.processing_context: LADCP LDEO IX.5; least-squares M2 tidal removal from depth-averaged currents; source-reported, not reproduced by OSW.

widths.range_interpretation: Reported jet narrower than 28 km in one dated snapshot; not a 28 km point, zero-to-28 interval, confidence bound, whole-current envelope or annual range.

widths.source_locator: Primary publisher indexed text: section 2 Observations paragraph 5; processing paragraph 4; Figure 1/2 captions establish section dates and 100 m horizontal-current context.
widths.source_quality_note: Primary publisher indexed passages/captions reviewed. Original PDF, figure pixels, fields and paired width edges unavailable. Width constraint describes a narrow jet within broader flow, not complete ASC width.
widths.time_convention: One observed section on 23 February 2009; January 31 is separate. Neither the 2010 publication date nor the M6 2017–2021 record dates this jet.
